rows.title: Net flow is credits minus debits
rows.defect: the net flow has the wrong sign

rows.title: Credits are not income
rows.defect: bank debits are reported as spending and credits as income
rows.test: spending and income stay unknown

rows.title: Pending is left out
rows.defect: the pending check is dropped
rows.test: a pending $90.00 hold is not in the debits

rows.title: Superseded is counted as such
rows.defect: superseded rows are not told apart
rows.test: a replaced pending row is superseded, not unavailable

rows.title: Only observed rows count
rows.defect: only rows marked not_seen are left out
rows.test: a row with no presence is unavailable

rows.title: The last day is in the range
rows.defect: the range's last day is left out
rows.test: Oct 31 counts in Oct 1 to Oct 31

rows.title: One account means one account
rows.defect: the account filter is dropped
rows.test: the savings report has only the $1,000.00

rows.title: Other currencies stay aside
rows.defect: the currency check is dropped
rows.test: a EUR 20.00 row is not $20.00

rows.title: Bank-labeled transfers stay aside
rows.defect: the transfer check is dropped
rows.test: a $500 transfer to savings is not a debit

rows.title: A re-read counts once
rows.defect: the fetch time is compared, so a re-read stops the report
rows.test: the same row fetched twice is one $15.49

rows.title: Conflicting copies stop the report
rows.defect: a repeated id is skipped without comparing its facts
rows.test: the same id at $15.49 and $15.94 throws

rows.title: Biggest money out first
rows.defect: the order is reversed
rows.test: rent before the two cafes

rows.title: One merchant, two spellings
rows.defect: the bank's raw text is grouped before the merchant key
rows.test: NETFLIX.COM and NETFLIX.COM 866-... are one merchant

rows.title: Unknown fetch time, unknown as-of
rows.defect: any fetch time is enough to state an as-of
rows.test: one row without a fetch time makes the as-of null

rows.title: Days in order
rows.defect: a reversed range is accepted
rows.test: Oct 31 to Oct 1 is refused

rows.title: A broken date stops the report
rows.defect: the posted-date check is dropped
rows.test: posted_on 2026-10-1 throws

rows.title: Unknown amounts stop the report
rows.defect: the amount check is dropped
rows.test: a null or 12.5-cent amount throws

rows.title: No rows, no as-of
rows.defect: the as-of is computed over no rows
rows.test: an empty range has oldest_receipt_at null

rows.title: Identity is required
rows.defect: the identity check is dropped
rows.test: a row with no transaction id throws

rows.title: Too big is unknown
rows.defect: a total past 2^53 is rounded and shown
rows.test: MAX_SAFE_INTEGER + 1 cents is null
